02 / ABOUT THE STUDIO

Small studio.
Big curiosity.

Shockit Games is an independent game studio making playful experiences for curious minds. We love colourful worlds, little discoveries, and games that invite you to keep exploring.

A REAL PERSON IS HERE TO HELP

Questions? Ideas?
